name: Nightlife District — Corner Cam
footage_note: EarthCam New Orleans street-view camera — real fixed city camera, recorded 2026-07-26; stand-in for a Santa Cruz nightlife corner, not this location.
agent_context: Bar-district street corner with heavy late-night foot traffic. The two incident patterns here are people lingering in the intersection while impaired, and ground-level medical events — collapse from intoxication or overdose. Both are time-critical at night when bystander attention is unreliable. Police and Fire/EMS co-respond in this district.
